name: Query MCP
ownerWords: virev.ai MCP that lets a customer's agent read-query the whole crawled index freely (10-15). And 10-15 23:58Z: "select만 되는게 아니라 \"팔로워 구간별로 좋아요 수 비율 분석해줘\" 이런 group by analytics도 되는거지??"
goal: A customer's agent can read-query the whole crawled index through prod https://virev.ai/mcp on both tiers: describe, sql and search answer for the standard and the full tier, and the owner's follower-bucket question (posts' likes grouped by the account's follower bucket over the whole index) answers in one sql call. Goal p542 closed on 10-19 at 23:22Z with 3 of 3 tools on both tiers; this duty keeps it. The check runs as the prod test user mcp-duty-checker (orgs org_mcp_duty_standard and org_mcp_duty_full), which stays for this duty.

metrics.label: Query MCP tools answering on prod, the lower of the two tiers
metrics.why: p542's done line: describe, sql and search answer a customer agent on prod, both tiers (3 of 3 on 10-19 17:30Z and 23:22Z).

metrics.label: Tiers where the follower-bucket sql answers on prod
metrics.why: The owner's 10-15 23:58Z ask must work in one sql call on both tiers; on 10-19 the standard tier answered it in 8.3 s once and hit its 10 s max_execution_time twice (10.05 s, 10.12 s).

onMiss: tools_answering: read the tier line in the run detail. HTTP 401 or invalid_token means the duty identity or the signing secret changed: re-create the connection with /api/mcp/connection/upsert and the dataApi grant with the org-contract route (c35). 'not configured', 'denied' or upstream 5xx means crawler-api, its QUERY_* URLs in apps/crawler-v3/.env or the ClickHouse query users broke: name the release that changed it, and fix it through the crawler ops train; ClickHouse users come back with deploy.sh's apply_query_mcp.py step. follower_bucket_tiers: a timeout on standard means q.instagram_post_counts outgrew mcp_standard's 10 s: start one fix job that makes the follower-bucket answer fit (for example a pre-bucketed q table refreshed with q.instagram_post_counts) and land it through the train. A source_error comes first: fix the precheck. Never ssh to us-metal01 (c146). All on target: end the turn with no message.
